verdict.rationale: The Agent API offers saved agent configurations called profiles, documented as "reusable, versioned configuration that you save and manage" (docs-35, docs-46). Separately, effort-level presets can be pinned to a dated release so a run stays on a known configuration after the preset moves on (docs-45). That covers the versioning part of the story, but there is no documented way to review changes between versions or to roll a profile back. The tool-call approvals feature (docs-61) reviews individual runtime calls, not changes to an automation's configuration, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented version history/diff review for profiles, an explicit rollback mechanism for user-defined automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
